title: FishAI observatory knowledge-graph edge metadata
description: Required payload on every KnowledgeEdge. Aligns evidence_type with observatory user_output_contract.md output classes and causal_status with the proposed causal-engine enum (causal_ecology/ was not present on 2026-09-18). Do not put NEVER_PUBLISH coordinates in geographic_applicability.

evidence_type.description: How this edge is known. Same vocabulary as user_output_contract.md §1.2, plus LITERATURE_SYNTHESIS and OFFICIAL_REGULATORY for catalog edges that are not observations.

source.description: Stable source node @id or official URL. Not a dump pointer. Catalog-only until rights approval.

citation.description: Human-readable citation. Papers are cited, not copied. License UNKNOWN until a rights pass.

confidence.description: Qualitative only unless a named validation result calibrates it. Matches commercial uncertainty policy language.

start.description: ISO date or datetime. Null if unknown.

region_id.description: OceanRegion or official-unit @id. Null only if applicability is explicitly 'unbounded' (discouraged).

items.description: LifeStage @id or taxonomy_standard.md code (egg, larva, juvenile, farmed_growout, ocean_immature_adult, …).

causal_status.description: Binding target for the causal engine. If observatory/causal_ecology/ later ships a different enum, migrate via the map in ontology.md §8 — do not silently rename.

last_updated.description: ISO date the edge was last edited in this graph.

privacy_tier.description: Optional. Defaults to the stricter of subject and object. PUBLIC projection strips PRIVATE and NEVER_PUBLISH edges.

decision_applicability.description: Optional. Which operator decision this edge may inform. Prevents Category-letter collisions (oyster D-stress vs Chinook D-encounter).

prediction_contract_category.description: Optional. A–E from the commercial prediction contract. E covariates are never abundance.

emiv_id.description: Optional. Registry variable_id from observatory/emiv/ (v0.1-draft), e.g. EMIV-PHY-ATEMP-001. Compound nodes may use A|B. Graph URN @id may still use the old slug path.
